summary: Phase A–D — Stratégie de rétention 90j soft-delete + réactivation. 22/24 tests PASSED (2 skipped expected due to idempotency from double-run). All endpoints verified: reactivatable, tag-point/service/product/user deactivate-reactivate cycles. Workers, routing, and frontend components all present.

minor.issue: Response uses 'ok:true' instead of 'success:true' — inconsistent with service/tag-point delete responses
Guard checks 'deleted_at' (shared with RGPD delete). Error message 'déjà désactivé' appears for RGPD-deleted users too — misleading but not blocking
Does not check 'anonymized_at' — could theoretically allow reactivation of RGPD-anonymized accounts (edge case, no realistic exploit path)
